notes: TrafficPolicy and SecurityProfile are WDS policy resources and do not alter CDS/LDS/RDS/PCDS generation.
The fixture explicitly sets the Agentio oracle inputs gateway connect timeout 7s and OS root CA path /etc/ssl/cert.pem.
Agentio explicitly disables the outer CONNECT route request timeout so long-lived tunnels are not capped by Envoy's default.

Agentio retains its explicit 10s timeout for main_internal and main_forward because the gateway connect timeout applies only to Passthrough and the two DFP clusters; unsetting the internal-hop timeout has no supported-path benefit and would change current failure behavior.
Agentio retains BlackHoleCluster because the SNI deny chain references it; the legacy Agentio graph omitted that referenced cluster.

Agentio matches release-0.1 sandbox route timeouts: explicit route timeouts also set max_grpc_timeout, and routes without a configured timeout explicitly disable the request timeout (timeout 0s plus zero-valued max_stream_duration) instead of falling back to Envoy default 15s.
